auth.loginTitle: Sign in to QA Testing Hub
auth.forgotPersonal: Forgot your password? Run on the Hub machine:
auth.setupDescription: Create the Owner account and your organization. This screen appears only once.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, no common passwords
auth.tagline: Test your websites in one place: test cases, runs, and reports anyone can read.
auth.point1: Test websites running on localhost, no need to deploy them
auth.point2: Per-project permissions, every important action is audited
auth.point3: Secrets are encrypted and never shown again in the UI
auth.apiDown: Cannot reach the Hub API. Check that the api is running (pnpm dev) and try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.changePasswordHint: Your other sessions will be signed out.

settings.membersHint: Email invitations are available in Server mode (Phase 8). Members added directly get a temporary password.
settings.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the organization? All of their sessions will be revoked.
settings.serviceAccountsHint: Tokens for CI/CD to submit results and create runs. Shown only once when created or rotated.
settings.revokeConfirm: Revoke this token? CI jobs using it will stop working immediately.

targets.title: Domains & local network
targets.hint: The Hub only sends requests to verified hosts. Local websites use the internal IP ranges below.
targets.localNetworkHint: Enabled once for the whole organization: localhost of the Hub machine (Personal mode) and LAN ranges allowed for testing.
targets.cidrs: Allowed internal IP ranges (CIDR, comma separated)
targets.empty: No domains yet. Local websites don't need to be added here.
targets.deleteConfirm: Remove this host from the allowlist? New runs against it will be blocked.

testing.title: Testing switches
testing.hint: When off, new runs cannot be created and schedules are paused. Every change is audited with a reason.
testing.productionTestingHint: Off by default. When on: still no writes, no active security scans, performance needs approval.
testing.localTestingHint: Websites on localhost or LAN IPs. On by default.
testing.productionWarning: Limits still apply: no writes · no active security scans · performance needs approval.

projects.archiveConfirm: Archive this project? Its data is kept.
